Failed requests may reuse data already held by the page with its fetch time shown. Reloading fetches again. The app writes no version snapshot to localStorage or IndexedDB; the browser HTTP cache follows browser policy. Lockfile constraints use bundled compatibility rules. Unknown formats retain manager identity with *; this does not claim a measured test pass.
